item_short_desc: Rothco’s 3-in-1 Survival Hatchet is a compact and convenient survival instrument that provides you with the tools you need to brave the wilderness in a sleek, low-profile design.
description: Rothco’s 3-in-1 Survival Hatchet is a compact and convenient survival instrument that provides you with the tools you need to brave the wilderness in a sleek, low-profile design. The hatchet blade is perfect for splitting small pieces of wood and can be sharpened for years of use. A blunt hammer edge on the survival axe is perfect for nails and tent stakes. The camping hatchet also features a two-prong pry bar and nail remover. The compact camping axe is easy-to-pack and includes a rubber blade protector for safe storage.
